allowed_local_bind_events.address_matching: Literal exact strings only; no DNS, aliases, integer IP forms, wildcards, nonloopback literals or nonzero IPv6 scope IDs. Validate socket family AF_INET/AF_INET6 and exact address tuple shape; integer port0..65535 excluding bool; IPv6 flowinfo/scopeid zero. Fail closed for any unverified address/class.
allowed_local_bind_events.mechanism: Noncommunicating local socket construction is permitted only to support these recorded binds; no listener or connection is permitted.
allowed_local_bind_events.receipt: Record each bind attempt before execution: event counter, exact address tuple, family/type/protocol metadata, bounded Python call stack, monotonic timestamp and success/failure. Distinct count allowed_local_bind_events; bind attempts classified unknown/nonallowed increment forbidden counter and raise.
